column2: Buildings are structures built by the survivor scavengers in their base of operations. In the survivor communities of this world, structures and buildings are far more than mere shelters; they are repurposed relics of a lost civilization that have been transformed into highly specialized environments for survival, production, and social organization

This basic utility facility burns salvaged fuel to supply a steady stream of electricity to primitive settlement networks. It is essential for lighting dark subterranean halls and powering early crafting tools to keep the enclave functional

Utilizing expanded wiring arrays and more efficient combustion chambers, this upgraded unit provides reliable energy for growing base grids. It allows communities to run heavier recycling machinery and keep larger security perimeters active throughout the night

This heavy industrial generator represents the peak of home-engineered power systems, converting vast amounts of fuel into a massive electrical supply. It is critical for electrifying advanced workshops, massive defensive barriers, and large-scale agricultural operations

A clean, dedicated sanctuary where injured scavengers can receive basic first aid, bandages, and chemical treatments. It plays a crucial role in preventing simple cuts from turning into fatal infections or triggering panic among the community

Outfitted with advanced bioscanners and rare surgical equipment, this facility provides complex surgical procedures to save dying operatives. Its presence dramatically improves the survival rates of survivors returning from hazardous excursions

This specialized quarantine wing is designed to isolate and examine individuals exposed to the self-replicating nanobot plague. It helps doctors slow down the cellular corruption process and manage the strict quarantine protocols needed to keep the general population safe

Equipped with specialized sterile beds and chemical-burn treatments, this wing focuses on rapidly healing severe physical trauma. It ensures that seasoned field teams can recover from explosive injuries or melting gear and return to duty quickly

A fortified checkpoint utilizing basic defenses, wood planks, and tripwire alarms to monitor the surrounding ruins. It provides a crucial early warning system against incoming threats and coordinates defensive gunfire

A heavy defense outpost reinforced with steel plating and equipped with advanced X-ray scanning stations to screen incoming travellers. It acts as an impenetrable shield that prevents infected intruders or hostile scavengers from breaching the base

This modification establishes a secure arsenal for storing and distributing critical ammunition reserves directly to the defenders. It ensures sentries never run dry during prolonged attacks and optimizes ammo usage during chaotic encounters

Incorporating high-elevation lookout towers and reinforced barricades, this upgrade enhances defensive visibility and cover. It allows sentinels to spot approaching threats from kilometers away and suppress them with long-range fire before they reach the gates

A simple kitchen and cultivation depot where survivors process moss and basic raw ingredients into edible meals. It is the lifeblood of daily survival, keeping the population nourished and maintaining high community morale

A sophisticated agricultural hub capable of managing aquaponics farms and complex nutrient systems. It provides an abundant, self-sustaining food supply that allows the community to grow without relying entirely on dangerous trade runs

This specialized dietary facility prepares high-calorie, nutrient-dense rations that bolster the stamina of field operatives. It keeps combat teams sharp, resilient, and better prepared to survive physical trauma in the field

Focusing on long-term preservation techniques, this upgrade produces lightweight, non-perishable food packs. It enables scavengers to undertake long-distance journeys into deep ruins without the risk of starvation

A workshop filled with hand tools where basic materials like wood and scrap metal are processed into useful gear. It is essential for repairing worn equipment and constructing basic structural elements for the base

An advanced machine shop equipped with high-tech power tools and metal presses to handle complex engineering tasks. It allows technicians to manufacture durable armor, repair heavy vehicles, and process high-quality alloys

This tech lab addition allows mechanics to assemble advanced wearable electronics like targeting systems and communication headsets. It gives field operatives a technological edge, dramatically improving their effectiveness in hostile environments

This upgrade adapts manufacturing tools to work with natural resources, allowing the creation of silent weapons, wood furnishings, and chemical lighting. It helps the community conserve its rare industrial supplies by utilizing renewable woodland and organic alternatives
A quiet workshop containing basic analytical tools, petri dishes, and books. It is vital for preserving pre-Collapse scientific knowledge and studying the baseline behavior of the world

A state-of-the-art laboratory equipped with pad-computers and spectrometers to analyze complex technological systems. It allows scientists to conduct advanced studies, moving the community closer to reclaiming lost technology

This high-security research wing focuses on analyzing the self-replicating nanobots causing the plague. By treating the infection as an engineering problem, researchers can develop specialized EMP emitters to permanently shut down the infected

This wing studies the advanced, self-learning technology of the alien visitors, particularly their multi-functional masks. It enables the base to adapt alien interfaces and hazard-scanning technology for human surviva

A central hub housing basic radio receivers and wiring arrays to maintain contact with nearby sectors. It serves as the community's ear to the wasteland, preventing absolute isolation in a fractured world

This high-frequency radio array allows the enclave to broadcast and receive long-distance signals across multiple regions. It helps coordinate rescue missions, trade caravans, and major cooperative efforts with distant settlements

By integrating trading desks and secure storage, this station becomes a recognized beacon for traveling merchants. It streamlines the exchange of batteries, ammunition, and fuel, boosting the local scavenger economy

Outfitted with advanced binoculars and remote mapping systems, this upgrade allows scouts to track movement in surrounding zones. It provides real-time intel on migrating infected hordes, keeping the community safe from surprise attacks

Work describes the daily activities of the survivors in the communities. This can have describe a plethora of different activities that are found to be meaningful in the current situation of the community. In survivor communities, work is synonymous with collective survival and the maintenance of isolation from the surface threats

Researchers investigate the core technological mysteries of the wasteland, focusing on infected behavior, alien artifact analysis, and nanobot reverse-engineering. They utilize specialized laboratory gear such as spectrometers, bioscanners, and pad-computers to analyze alien technology and study nanobot mechanics. Researching can be synthesising knowledge from seemingly out of nowhere, analysing old forgotten technology or analysing new alien technology - figuring out what it is made of and how people could replicate it. Research brings hope for the future, and makes life easier in the world that has completely changed, research brings even more change, but aims for the better outcomes and quality of life.
Source is currently doing researching work.
Target is currently doing researching work.

Firearms operatives concentrate on ballistics development, ammunition fabrication, perimeter guarding, and automated turret deployment. Their work centers on forging high-grade projectiles, constructing fortified watchposts, and maintaining armed stockpiles to defend settlements against fast-moving infected variants and hostile surface threats. Because ammunition functions as both the ultimate defensive tool and the primary currency of the wasteland economy, firearms specialists ensure that human enclaves remain economically viable and prepared to repel sudden sieges.
Source is doing Firearms work
Target is doing Firearms work

Food specialists manage community sustenance through rooftop crop cultivation, moss farming, food distillation, and ration preservation. They process agricultural yields into nutrient-dense combat rations for field operatives and lightweight, non-perishable provisions for deep wasteland expeditions. With resource scarcity posing a constant threat to human survival, this work keeps scavenging teams energized during surface runs, improves baseline morale, and prevents isolated settlements from collapsing due to starvation
Source is doing Food work
Target is doing Food work

Mechanical technicians are responsible for structural engineering, tech crafting, nature-based fabrication, and renewable power infrastructure. They recycle raw metals, plastic, and timber into essential base defenses, build field optics, and assemble wearable electronics like targeting systems and communication headsets. Their labor is essential for keeping settlement power grids functional, maintaining heavy recycling machinery, and equipping field teams with protective armor and silent tactical gear.
Source is doing mechanical work
Target is doing mechanical work

Communication specialists focus on radio array operations, wasteland scouting, trade route development, and community cohesion. They use long-range transmitters and observation optics to map surrounding ruins, spot incoming infected movements, and establish contact with distant outposts. In an era where isolated enclaves easily succumb to suspicion and resource deprivation, communication workers secure trade connections for vital commodities like batteries and food while maintaining unity across surviving human settlements.
Source is doing communication work
Target is doing communication work

Medical specialists focus on preserving human survival through wound treatment, infected containment, autopsies, and mental resilience training. Their daily work involves running specialized quarantine wings, performing surgical procedures on injured scavengers, and formulating health kits as well as nanobot-targeting pharmaceuticals. In a world where the infection is driven by microscopic alien nanobots causing continuous tissue corruption and bodily resurrections, medical personnel are vital for maintaining strict quarantine protocols, slowing cellular breakdown, and protecting enclave well-being

A character’s background reflects the specific environment where they endured the global collapse. Whether they were raised in the electrified, underground tunnels or among the rooftop gardens of a fortified skyscraper, these origins define their practical skills and social standing. These past experiences influence a character’s perspective, determining if they are more interested in daily scavenging for resources or the long-term pursuit of a technical cure for example.

Grew up in a government bunker or secret research facility, taught about the world from old books and archives. Released into the new world with theoretical knowledge but little practical experience. Raised within isolated underground research bunkers, these individuals acquired vast theoretical knowledge by studying archived texts and old-world literature. Having lived shielded from the surface collapse, they enter the post-apocalyptic world with exceptional technical understanding but virtually no practical field experience.
Source's background is Vault-Raised
Target's background is Vault-Raised

Lived in the ruins of a city, scavenging for food, hiding from both aliens and hostile human factions. These scavengers spent their lives navigating the rotting concrete and chest-high vegetation of derelict city ruins. Survival has taught them to stealthily forage overgrown streets while evading roaming infected mobs, hostile human factions, and alien patrols.
Source's background is Urban Dweller
Target's background is is Urban Dweller

Born in remote wilderness camps long after the downfall of human civilization, these survivors possess no memory of life prior to the Collapse. Accustomed to gathering timber and living off the land, they view the ruined metropolitan towers as mysterious, ancient monuments rather than former homes
Source's background is Wildborn
Target's background is is Wildborn

Former combatants who fought in organized defense forces during the initial outbreak, they carry deep psychological trauma from watching human resistance crumble. Their extensive training with firearms, tactical barricades, and perimeter defense makes them formidable guardians for any settlement. They survived, but at great personal cost.
Source's background is Professional Military
Target's background is is Professional Military

Devotees of a cultic doctrine surrounding the extraterrestrial visitors, these survivors revere the orbital colony vessel and its advanced technology as divine. Rather than viewing the nanobot plague as a disaster, they interpret the microscopic machines as a transcendent force meant to remake humanity.
Source's background is Alien Worshipper
Target's background is is Alien Worshipper

Carrying over skills from pre-Collapse organised crime, these individuals excel at smuggling, black-market extortion, and covert logistics. They navigate the wasteland economy with ease, acquiring scarce commodities like ammunition reserves, fuel, and batteries through shrewd barter and illicit trade networks
Source's background is Syndicate Operative
Target's background is is Syndicate Operative

Captured by extraterrestrials and subjected to invasive procedures before escaping, this survivor carries deep physical and neurological scars from advanced alien medical technology. Although free from captivity, their altered internal physiology grants them unusual cellular resilience and heightened sensory awareness, while leaving them constantly struggling with the unsettling, non-human technology intertwined with their body
Source's background is Alien Experiment Survivor
Target's background is is Alien Experiment Survivor

Descended from influential families who attempted to ride out the apocalypse inside fortified private compounds, this survivor lost everything when those enclaves eventually failed. Stripped of their former wealth, they must now engage in hard physical labor alongside ordinary scavengers to earn daily meals.
Source's background is Aristocrat
Target's background is is Aristocrat

Trained medical personnel who served on the front lines during the initial crisis, treating severe injuries and enforcing early containment procedures. Their expertise in surgical procedures, wound dressing, and quarantine management is critical for keeping field teams alive and preventing outbreaks.
Source's background is Emergency Responder.
Target's background is is Emergency Responder.

Former industrial builders who constructed pre-Collapse infrastructure, these specialists adapt their trade to erect base defenses and housing. They specialize in working with wooden planks, metal barricades, and plastic windbreaks to expand living quarters and fortify agricultural rooftops
Source's background is Construction Worker
Target's background is is Construction Worker

This character's past is largely unknown—even to themselves. Amnesia, deliberate secrecy, or something else? Solitary wanderers whose true origins remain hidden behind deliberate secrecy or trauma-induced memory loss. Moving quietly between trading posts and overgrown ruins, they survive by relying strictly on self-sufficiency without forming lasting attachments to any single community.
Source's background is Drifter
Target's background is is Drifter

Before the apocalypse, they were a musician, painter, or writer—always wandering, seeking beauty in life. Artisans, musicians, and storytellers who refuse to let human culture disappear into dark sewer tunnels or barren rooftops. By preserving old-world literature, art, and music, they provide essential morale and cultural continuity to communities struggling against despair.
Source's background is Traveling Artist
Target's background is is Traveling Artist

Visionary thinkers fascinated by philosophy and ancient lore, these individuals cling to the belief that humanity can build something greater than mere daily survival. Even while hauling battery carts or farming underground moss, they actively search for knowledge and hope to guide the future. Always lost in thought, fascinated by philosophy, mythology, or stories of a better world. When everything collapsed, they clung to the belief that there’s still hope, even if it’s fading.
Source's background is Dreamer
Target's background is is Dreamer

A former police officer, security chief, or corporate enforcer who saw the old world fall apart and refused to let chaos take over. They believe in order, rules, and discipline. Usually working as agents and corporate security personnel who refuse to let lawlessness destroy surviving enclaves. They enforce strict settlement regulations, conduct thorough quarantine inspections, and maintain rigorous defense protocols to protect their people from internal chaos and contamination
Source's background is Former Police Officer
Target's background is is Former Police Officer

Beliefs are the core convictions that dictate how a survivor navigates a world defined by decay and alien influence. These values often center on the nature of the threat - specifically whether the infection is viewed as a biological curse or a technical computer problem that can be solved through engineering. A character's outlook is also shaped by their stance on isolationism versus expansion and their willingness to use intrusive technology. Ultimately, these beliefs determine if an individual prioritises the preservation of human culture and knowledge or adopts a ruthless, transactional approach to survival or if they have lost all hope and have allowed despair to guide their life now.

This belief places high value on computers, digital technology, and code purity. Adherents consider nanobots to be a technological malfunction that can potentially be repaired using electromagnetic pulse (EMP) devices. EMP devices are therefore considered particularly valuable. They generally prefer digital systems over analog ones and favor the automation of mechanical tasks. Basic activities associated with farming and nature are viewed as less desirable.
Target's belief is Techno Purist
Target's belief is Techno Purist

Influence by Alien Technology, this belief suggests that human emotion is a liability. Adherents embrace the Alien Technology's ability to pump hormones like endorphins and serotonin to maintain a state of hyper-rationality during combat, believing that "feeling" is what gets you killed
Source's Belief is Ultra Rationalist
Target's belief is Ultra Rationalist

This belief views relationships and agreements primarily in transactional terms. Adherents evaluate situations according to their costs and benefits and do not consider emotional or moral connections to be inherently important. Alliances are regarded as temporary agreements that exist for a specific purpose and period. They generally view resources and opportunities as limited, resulting in a largely zero-sum view of life.
Source's belief is Material Imperative
Target's belief is Material Imperative

This belief considers nature to be a conscious part of the natural order and views humanity as one component of that system. Adherents believe that nature will eventually recover without human intervention and therefore favor adaptation over rebuilding civilization. They place little inherent value on the achievements of the past and accept an uncertain future without attempting to control it. Human activity is generally expected to adjust to the environment rather than reshape it.
Source's belief is Gaia's Child
Target's belief is Gaia's Child

This belief is centered on a strong sense of betrayal. Adherents maintain a strong belief in God but believe that God failed humanity during the collapse. They generally consider themselves to have acted correctly and attribute humanity's abandonment by God to the actions of others. They associate advanced technology with the collapse and therefore distrust or oppose it. They also distrust aliens, viewing them as false prophets whose arrival contributed to humanity's downfall.
Source's belief is God's Betrayed
Target's belief is God's Betrayed

This belief holds that nanobots can provide a path toward immortality and eventual ascension. Adherents seek to understand nanobots and the infected, but generally do not want to expose themselves to infection. They value rational thought while continuing to accept the importance of emotions. They have a generally positive view of aliens and regard the transformation caused by nanobots as potentially beneficial. Research and experimentation on infected individuals are considered valuable for understanding this potential transformation.
Source's belief is Hive-Mind Ascensionist
Target's belief is Hive-Mind Ascensionist

This belief places greater value on tangible evidence and present circumstances than on unverified claims about the past or future. Adherents generally avoid unnecessary risks, particularly when the potential consequences are distant or uncertain. Their approach to the future focuses primarily on reducing potential losses rather than pursuing uncertain rewards. When evaluating risks, they give greater weight to possible negative outcomes than to possible positive outcomes.
Source's belief is Skeptic
Target's belief is Skeptic

Lore is the accumulated knowledge or understanding of events that took place held by the survivors, about any subject, especially when passed from generation to generation by oral and written tradition. Lore is the events of the world as the survivors experienced it and everyone has a different way of interpreting it to fit their particular backgrounds, beliefs, factions and personalities.

In this world, lore is the fragmented legacy of a fallen civilisation, passed by the survivors to ensure cultural continuity. It is the collective memory of a time when the Aliens were first encountered. For some, lore is a technical record of the events; for others, it is a collection of bedside stories used to warn children of the ghostly threats that haunt the reclaimed urban ruins. Ultimately, lore is the subjective history of survival, where every scavenger interprets events of the world through the lens of their own struggle to endure

The first signal means the time 30 years ago when alien life forms existence was confirmed when alien mothership was still on-route to Earth. It was an unexpected transmission from an alien intelligence, relayed back to Earth by the New Horizon space probe past Pluto. Kept secret for several months, this message established two-way communication between humanity and the alien settlers, setting in motion the timeline that led to public disclosure and the eventual arrival of their massive colony ship in Earth's orbit. This represented humanity's initial confirmation of extraterrestrial intelligence, although kept secret for several months, its eventual public disclosure shifted global perception from initial panic to curiosity, hope, and eventual acceptance. Rather than announcing a hostile invasion, the message heralded the peaceful immigration of a colossal alien clony vessel carrying millions of settlers. For humankind, the signal initially symbolised an era of profound promise and technological brotherhood. However, it ultimately served as the unwitting precursor to global catastrophe, setting in motion the timeline that introduced alien nanobots to Earth and culminated in the collapse of human civilization.

Infection Day 0 refers to first occurances when nanobots had jumped to human bodies but it was not yet a global problem. This caused global worry, but initially its severity was not foreseen in the scale it should have been. This happened some 24 years ago.

Infected: Commonly referred to by survivors as zombies, the infected are described as sickly looking people who appear ghostly or like skeletons with skin. They are far from slow-moving; they shriek, move with terrifying speed, and can spread the nanobot scourge rapidly through bites. Their presence has forced humanity into extreme isolation, founding their communities either deep underground, high above ground or surrounded by water

Infected Resurrection is one of the most terrifying aspects of the nanobot plague is the inability to easily dispatch the infected. Because the nanobots are programmed for constant biological repair, they furiously mend any damage inflicted upon the host body. Even when an infected individual appears to have been killed, the nanobots can succeed in resurrecting the fallen, creating what survivors describe as an endless, regenerating nightmare.

The Alien Mothership is a colossal, generational colony vessel several kilometres in length. It remains trapped in orbit because it is too gargantuan to make a direct atmospheric descent safely. The Aliens are currently engaged in a monumental project to construct powerful new engines around the vessel to enable a landing, a task that requires vast amounts of terrestrial fuel and building materials, driving their desperate trade with human scavengers. The Alien terraforming projects which drove the cities to ruin and drove people out as survivors are happening because of the mothership. The Aliens need all the materials they can get to prepare a landing site.

Fog has become a lot more common than it should have been. The Alien Terraforming efforts are behind this change, whatever they are doing is bringing a lot of more water particles about. Survivors find the new kind of fog scary, that is because The Fog is associated with danger as the infected seem to be more active and can lurk closer to survivors before being noticed when they are enshourded by fog. When the wind is blowing, this means fog cannot linger. Because of this the wind has become a symbol of hope and change for the better. Where the wind blows, the evil cannot hide. Survivors are getting more and more spiritual about the wind. They are bringing back old symbolism and folklore about the wind into their day to day lives. Many new puns and saying have been born out of the evergoing tug of war between fog and wind.

Barrication of the Canal, is a local decision to build a landmark to keep the infected from spreading. It has accomplished its task, making the area outside of the barricade relatively safe. The building of the barrication to Portage Canal and its lift bridge, basically isolating Keweenaw peninsula from the rest of the continent is generally well accepted by the survivors. The building of the barricade allowed to create the north side into a relative safe space by slowly eradicating the infected, even though they somehow seem to creep in slowly through the barricade every once in a while. However the danger on the southside is multiple times worse.
